spots.name: Sunshine Butte
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 330 m (1,083 ft).

spots.name: Rock Creek Pass
spots.tip: A mountain pass: easy high ground by car. Fog often fills the valleys on either side at sunrise; check winter road conditions.

spots.name: Sandy Swimming Hole
